title: Factor definition
description: A cost factor supplied by the host. Unknown fields and values are rejected.

applies_on.description: The date this record applies to; drives every point-in-time check.

material_key.description: Material key as read from ITEM_DESCRIPTION. Nylon cord v0.1: 840D/2, 1260D/2, 840D/1, 1890D/2, 1260D/1, chafer. Database doc ids use a slug with / replaced by - (840D-2).

data_source.description: Ordered series_ids; the first with a value inside tolerance wins.

lag.description: ISO 8601 duration, date part only (e.g. P0D, P1M, P3M, P14D).

window.description: ISO 8601 duration, date part only (e.g. P0D, P1M, P3M, P14D).

max_staleness.description: ISO 8601 duration, date part only (e.g. P0D, P1M, P3M, P14D).

default_weight.description: Share of price in the base month. The sum per material must be <= 1 (checked across documents by the contract loader).

fx_series.description: Series used to convert this factor into the purchase currency at the delivery date; null for unitless indexes.

host_cause.description: Causal Identifier target: a causes[].id (e.g. cpl-supply) or delivered:<name> (e.g. delivered:freight, delivered:usdpkr). Optional; set at integration (decision Q3, 2 Nov 2026).
